svg.title: The run that ends last commits
svg.desc: A check of a commit fails and keeps a fix. The job of the fix bot waits for the other checks of the commit that keep fixes, up to a quarter of an hour. When they have all ended, it makes one commit with every fix. When one still runs, it depends on where the fixes go. A suggestion on a fork and the pull request of main cancel no run, so they take what has ended. On a branch of the repository, the bot commits nothing, as a commit would cancel the run that still goes. The end of that run starts the job again, however it ended, and that job looks again. Once a job has made the commit, any other job of that commit finds a new head and commits nothing.
